lsd.dose: Blotters rarely match their label: start with half a tab and wait 2 hours before taking more.
lsd.prepare: Ehrlich reagent turns purple for LSD. A bitter or numbing blotter is likely an NBOMe: spit it out.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Tolerance builds overnight, lasts ~2 weeks and carries over to mushrooms and mescaline.

lsd.dependence: Not compulsive: tolerance makes repeated use pointless.

risks.title: Difficult trips
risks.text: Panic and confusion can lead to risky behaviour. Have a sober sitter and a calm place.

risks.title: Mental health
risks.text: Can trigger psychosis or mania with a personal or family history of psychosis or bipolar disorder.

risks.title: Lithium
risks.text: Seizures reported when combined with lithium. Never mix.

actions: Move somewhere calm, quiet and dim
Reassure them: it's the drug and it will pass
Call 112 for seizures, chest pain or if they can't be kept safe

mushrooms.dose: Potency varies between species and batches. Weigh them; start around 1 g with a new batch.
mushrooms.prepare: Effects can take up to 2 hours: don't redose early. Ginger tea helps with nausea.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Tolerance lasts ~2 weeks and is shared with LSD and mescaline.

mushrooms.dependence: Not compulsive: tolerance makes repeated use pointless.

risks.title: Difficult trips
risks.text: Panic and confusion can lead to risky behaviour. Have a sober sitter and a calm place.

risks.title: Mental health
risks.text: Can trigger psychosis or mania with a personal or family history of psychosis or bipolar disorder.

risks.title: Wrong mushroom
risks.text: Misidentified wild mushrooms can cause fatal liver failure. Only eat species identified with certainty.

signs: Severe stomach pain hours later (wrong mushroom)
actions: Move somewhere calm, quiet and dim
Reassure them: it's the drug and it will pass
Call 112 if they can't be kept safe or a wild mushroom may be poisonous

dmt.dose: Use a milligram scale: 10–15 mg vaporised is light, breakthrough doses start around 25 mg.
dmt.prepare: Sit or lie down before inhaling and let a sitter take the pipe: you can lose your body within seconds.

spacing.label: Little tolerance
spacing.text: Tolerance barely builds, but take time to process each experience before repeating.

risks.title: Sudden onset
risks.text: Full effects within a minute: falls and burns if standing or holding a flame.

risks.title: Ayahuasca
risks.text: Oral DMT needs an MAOI, which is dangerous with SSRIs, stimulants, MDMA and tramadol.

risks.title: Heart
risks.text: Heart rate and blood pressure rise sharply. Risky with heart conditions.

actions: Keep them seated or on their side, away from flames
Reassure: smoked effects fade within 10–20 minutes
Call 112 for seizures, breathing problems or fever with stiffness

mescaline.dose: Doses are for mescaline HCl. Cactus potency varies widely: start with a small portion.
mescaline.prepare: Expect strong nausea and a slow onset (1–3 h). Don't redose before 3 hours.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Tolerance lasts ~2 weeks and is shared with LSD and mushrooms.

mescaline.dependence: Not compulsive: tolerance makes repeated use pointless.

risks.title: Long trip
risks.text: 6–12 hours. Plan a safe place and a free next day.

risks.title: Mental health
risks.text: Can trigger psychosis or mania with a personal or family history.

risks.title: Heart
risks.text: Raises heart rate and blood pressure.

actions: Move somewhere calm, quiet and dim
Small sips of water; recovery position if drowsy and vomiting
Call 112 for chest pain, seizures or if they can't be kept safe

dox.dose: Potency varies 5× across the family (DOB, DOC, DOI, DOM).
dox.prepare: Often sold on blotters as LSD. Ehrlich reagent: purple = LSD, no change = possibly DOx.
dox.marginNote: No human data. Overdoses mostly follow mistaking DOx for LSD or redosing before it kicks in.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Shares tolerance with other psychedelics. The trip itself can last a whole day.

risks.title: Delayed onset
risks.text: Can take 3 hours to start: redosing is the classic route to overdose.

risks.title: Vasoconstriction
risks.text: Cold, numb limbs and high blood pressure. Risky with heart disease or stimulants.

risks.title: Very long
risks.text: 12–30 hours with little sleep.

signs: Very high blood pressure or chest pain
actions: Call 112 for seizures, chest pain or high temperature
Keep them cool and calm in a quiet place
Recovery position if unresponsive

nbomes.dose: Active below 1 mg: impossible to dose by eye. Never snort or swallow powders or liquids.
nbomes.prepare: Bitter or numbing taste = likely NBOMe. If you expected LSD, spit it out.
nbomes.marginNote: No reliable safety margin: deaths reported at doses close to normal ones.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Shares tolerance with other psychedelics. Safer to avoid entirely.

risks.title: Seizures & heart
risks.text: Fast heart, vasoconstriction, overheating and seizures.

risks.title: Deaths at low doses
risks.text: Especially when snorted or combined with stimulants.

risks.title: Agitation
risks.text: Violent confusion has been reported.

actions: Call 112 straight away
Cool them down; clear the space around them
Recovery position if unresponsive

2c-x.dose: Other 2Cs differ a lot in strength: never swap doses between them.
2c-x.prepare: Weigh with a milligram scale. Test unknown powders: some '2C-B' is another 2C or an NBOMe.
2c-x.marginNote: No safety-ratio data. Steep dose curve: a few mg make a big difference.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Shares tolerance with other psychedelics.

risks.title: Steep dose curve
risks.text: A little more can be much stronger.

risks.title: Serotonergic
risks.text: Risky with MAOIs and tramadol.

risks.title: Body load
risks.text: Nausea, chills and difficult trips are common at higher doses.

actions: Move somewhere calm and cool
Reassure them: it's the drug and it will pass
Call 112 for seizures, chest pain or high temperature

2c-t-x.dose: Slow onset (1–2 h): don't redose. Never snort.
2c-t-x.prepare: Weigh with a milligram scale and dissolve in water to split doses accurately.
2c-t-x.marginNote: No safety-ratio data. Deaths reported with 2C-T-7 and 2C-T-21, some after snorting or with MAOIs.

spacing.label: Tolerance
spacing.text: Shares tolerance with other psychedelics.

risks.title: MAOIs
risks.text: Severe, possibly fatal reactions.

risks.title: Snorting
risks.text: Deaths linked to insufflating 2C-T-7.

risks.title: Long and heavy
risks.text: Nausea and a long, intense trip.

actions: Call 112 for seizures or high temperature
Cool them down in a calm place
Recovery position if unresponsive

5-meo-xxt.dose: Several times stronger than DMT: start at 2–3 mg on a milligram scale.
5-meo-xxt.prepare: Lie down with a sober sitter. Losing control of the body and vomiting are common.
5-meo-xxt.marginNote: No safety-ratio data. Fatal reactions reported when combined with MAOIs (e.g. ayahuasca).

spacing.label: Little tolerance
spacing.text: Overwhelming even at low doses: take time to integrate before repeating.

risks.title: MAOIs
risks.text: Fatal reactions with ayahuasca or harmala.

risks.title: Loss of control
risks.text: Thrashing, falls and vomiting while unaware.

risks.title: Mental health
risks.text: Very intense: psychosis risk with a personal or family history.

signs: Vomiting while lying on their back
actions: Recovery position to keep the airway clear
Call 112 for seizures or no response after 30 minutes
Tell paramedics about any MAOI

cannabis.dose: Edibles: start with 5 mg THC or less and wait 2 hours. They last 4–10 hours.
cannabis.prepare: Skip the tobacco; vaping flower is gentler on the lungs. Don't drive for at least 6 hours.
cannabis.marginNote: No known fatal overdose. Greening out is unpleasant but passes.

spacing.label: Tolerance break
spacing.text: Daily use builds dependence. A 2–4 week break resets tolerance.

cannabis.dependence: About 1 in 10 users become dependent, more with daily use.

risks.title: Anxiety & panic
risks.text: Common with high-THC strains and edibles.

risks.title: Psychosis
risks.text: Higher risk with high THC, daily use, youth or a family history.

risks.title: Synthetics
risks.text: Sprayed 'CBD weed' and vapes can contain synthetic cannabinoids: seizures.

actions: Sit or lie down somewhere calm
Sip water or a sugary drink; reassure
Call 112 for chest pain, seizures or unconsciousness

ketamine.dose: Start with a small bump (10–20 mg) and wait 15 minutes: more tips into a K-hole fast.
ketamine.prepare: Crush finely, use your own straw and rinse your nose with water afterwards.

spacing.label: Protect your bladder
spacing.text: Weekly or more use drives bladder damage and dependence. Leave weeks between sessions.

ketamine.dependence: Tolerance and compulsive use build quickly with frequent use.

risks.title: Bladder damage
risks.text: Pain, urgency or blood in urine: stop and see a doctor. It can become permanent.

risks.title: Accidents
risks.text: Numbness and poor coordination: falls, burns, drowning. Never in water or alone.

risks.title: Depressants
risks.text: With alcohol, GHB, benzos or opioids: vomiting while unconscious, breathing stops.

actions: Recovery position and stay with them
Call 112 if they can't be woken or breathing is weak
Tell paramedics about alcohol, GHB or other depressants

mxe.dose: About 3× stronger than ketamine. Wait an hour before redosing.
mxe.prepare: Weigh with a milligram scale. Lasts 3–6 h, with after-effects into the next day.
mxe.marginNote: No safety-ratio data; much stronger than ketamine.

spacing.label: Protect your bladder
spacing.text: Like ketamine, frequent use risks bladder damage and dependence.

mxe.dependence: Similar to ketamine: compulsive use with frequent dosing.

risks.title: Blood pressure
risks.text: Raises heart rate and blood pressure.

risks.title: Serotonin
risks.text: Risky with MDMA, SSRIs, tramadol and DXM.

risks.title: Depressants
risks.text: With alcohol, GHB or opioids: breathing problems.

signs: Chest pain or very fast heart
actions: Recovery position and stay with them
Call 112 if they can't be woken or have chest pain
Keep them calm and cool

dxm.dose: Doses scale with body weight (mg/kg). Set your weight to see doses in mg.
dxm.prepare: Only use products where DXM is the ONLY active ingredient: paracetamol, antihistamines or guaifenesin can be deadly at these doses.

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.text: Leave 1–2 weeks between trips so tolerance and serotonin can recover.

dxm.dependence: Tolerance and compulsive use reported with regular use.

risks.title: Serotonin syndrome
risks.text: With SSRIs, MDMA, MAOIs or tramadol. Potentially fatal.

risks.title: Slow metabolisers
risks.text: ~1 in 10 people break DXM down slowly: much stronger, longer effects.

risks.title: Overheating
risks.text: Plus nausea and vomiting. Keep cool.

actions: Call 112
Cool them down
Recovery position if drowsy

nitrous.dose: One balloon at a time, normal breaths of air in between. Never inhale straight from a cracker or tank, or with a bag over your head.
nitrous.prepare: Fill a balloon first: gas straight from the canister is freezing and burns lips and throat. Sit down.

spacing.label: Protect your nerves
spacing.text: Heavy or frequent use depletes vitamin B12, causing numbness and nerve damage.

nitrous.dependence: Mostly psychological; heavy repeated use is common.

risks.title: Fainting & falls
risks.text: Sit down before inhaling.

risks.title: Lack of oxygen
risks.text: Never use bags, masks or closed spaces.

risks.title: Nerve damage
risks.text: Tingling or numb hands and feet: stop and see a doctor.

actions: Get them into fresh air
Recovery position; call 112
CPR if they're not breathing

amphetamines.dose: Purity varies wildly: start small and wait before redosing.
amphetamines.prepare: Eat first, plan your sleep and sip water. Use your own straw.

spacing.label: No binges
spacing.text: Avoid consecutive days; sleep and eat properly before next time. Comedowns build with each day of use.

amphetamines.dependence: Moderate for speed, very high for crystal meth.

risks.title: Heart & overheating
risks.text: Racing heart, high blood pressure, heatstroke when dancing.

risks.title: Sleep loss & paranoia
risks.text: Long sessions can cause paranoia and psychosis.

risks.title: Crystal meth
risks.text: Much stronger, longer-lasting and more addictive.

signs: Chest pain, racing or irregular heart
actions: Call 112 for chest pain, seizures or confusion
Cool them down somewhere calm
Sips of water, not litres

mdma.dose: Upper limit: 1.5 mg/kg for men, 1.3 mg/kg for women. Set your body below to calculate.
mdma.prepare: Test it (drug checking, Marquis + Simon's). Pills often contain 150 mg or more: start with a quarter or half.

spacing.label: 3-month rule
spacing.text: Serotonin needs time to recover. More often means weaker highs and harder comedowns.

mdma.dependence: Frequent use erodes the effects and mood.

risks.title: Overheating
risks.text: Take breaks from dancing, cool off and sip 300–500 ml of water per hour.

risks.title: Too much water
risks.text: Litres of water can cause fatal hyponatraemia. Sip, don't chug; isotonic drinks help.

risks.title: Redosing
risks.text: More MDMA brings more heat, strain and comedown, not more magic.

actions: Call 112 and say it's MDMA
Cool them: shade, wet cloths, fan
Don't force water; recovery position if unresponsive

cocaine.dose: Purity in Europe is often high: start with a small line (20–30 mg) and wait 20 minutes.
cocaine.prepare: Use your own straw (hepatitis C). Rinse your nose afterwards. Test for adulterants if you can.

spacing.label: Break the cycle
spacing.text: Craving builds fast: avoid consecutive days and all-night binges. Set a limit before you start.

cocaine.dependence: Short highs drive compulsive redosing; crack even more so.

risks.title: Heart & stroke
risks.text: Chest pain, arrhythmia and stroke, even in young people.

risks.title: With alcohol
risks.text: Forms cocaethylene: more toxic to the heart and longer-lasting.

risks.title: Redosing
risks.text: Effects fade in 30–60 minutes, pushing more and more lines.

actions: Call 112 for chest pain or seizures
Keep them calm and cool
Recovery position if unresponsive

caffeine.dose: Coffee ≈ 80–100 mg · energy drink ≈ 80 mg/250 ml · pills 100–200 mg.
caffeine.prepare: Pure caffeine powder is dangerous: a teaspoon can kill. Never measure by eye.

spacing.label: Per day
spacing.text: EFSA safe daily limit for adults (200 mg if pregnant). Avoid within 6 hours of sleep.

risks.title: Heart & anxiety
risks.text: Palpitations, jitters and panic at high doses.

risks.title: Powder & pills
risks.text: Easy to overdose by accident.

risks.title: Sleep
risks.text: Disrupts sleep even when you feel fine.

actions: Call 112 for chest pain, irregular heart or seizures
Always call if powder or pills were involved
Stop caffeine, rest, sip water

alcohol.dose: 1 unit = 10 ml of pure alcohol: about half a pint of beer or a single shot.
alcohol.prepare: Eat first, alternate with water and set a limit. Never drive.

spacing.label: Per week
spacing.text: Spread over 3 or more days, with several alcohol-free days each week (UK guidance).

alcohol.dependence: Withdrawal after heavy daily drinking can be fatal.

risks.title: Depressants
risks.text: With GHB, benzos, opioids or ketamine, breathing can stop.

risks.title: Choking
risks.text: Put very drunk friends in the recovery position.

risks.title: Accidents & violence
risks.text: Risk-taking, falls, drowning and fights.

signs: Cold, pale or blue skin; vomiting while passed out
actions: Recovery position, call 112
Stay with them and keep them warm
No coffee or cold showers

ghb/gbl.dose: Measure with an oral syringe. GBL is about twice as strong as GHB. Wait at least 2 hours before more.
ghb/gbl.prepare: Never with alcohol. Write down your dosing times or set a timer, and tell a friend.

spacing.label: Dependence
spacing.text: Daily use can cause dependence within weeks; withdrawal can be life-threatening: stop with medical help.

ghb/gbl.dependence: Rated moderate in 2007, but daily use leads to severe dependence.

risks.title: Tiny margin
risks.text: The step from euphoria to unconscious is very small.

risks.title: With alcohol
risks.text: Unconsciousness and stopped breathing.

risks.title: GBL burns
risks.text: Never drink it neat: dilute, and label the bottle.

actions: Recovery position, call 112
Stay with them: never let them 'sleep it off'
Tell paramedics how much and when

opioids.dose: Potency varies 100× between opioids (fentanyl and nitazenes work in micrograms) and tolerance drops after a few days off.
opioids.prepare: Carry naloxone, never use alone, test for fentanyl or nitazenes and try a small test dose first.

spacing.label: After any break
spacing.text: Tolerance drops within days. After detox, hospital, prison or a pause, use far less.

opioids.dependence: Physical dependence develops within weeks of daily use.

risks.title: Breathing stops
risks.text: The main cause of death, much worse with alcohol, benzos or GHB.

risks.title: Fentanyl & nitazenes
risks.text: Hidden in heroin and fake pills. Active in micrograms.

risks.title: Infections
risks.text: Never share needles or equipment: HIV, hepatitis C.

signs: Can't be woken; slow or no breathing, gurgling
actions: Call 112 and give naloxone; repeat after 2–3 min if needed
Rescue breaths or CPR; then recovery position
Stay: naloxone can wear off before the opioid

tramadol.dose: Ceiling effect: more tramadol mainly adds seizure risk, not more euphoria.
tramadol.prepare: Avoid with epilepsy, antidepressants or other serotonergic drugs.
tramadol.marginNote: No safety-ratio data. Seizure risk rises above ~300 mg; never exceed 400 mg/day.

spacing.label: Dependence
spacing.text: Daily use leads to opioid dependence and a difficult withdrawal.

risks.title: Seizures
risks.text: Risk rises with dose and with stimulants.

risks.title: Serotonin syndrome
risks.text: With SSRIs, MDMA, MAOIs or DXM.

risks.title: Breathing
risks.text: With alcohol, benzos or other opioids.

actions: Call 112
Give naloxone if breathing is slow
Protect their head during a seizure, then recovery position

benzodiazepines.dose: Benzos differ 20× in strength: 0.5 mg alprazolam ≈ 10 mg diazepam.
benzodiazepines.prepare: Fake 'Xanax' and street pills often contain stronger benzos. Start with a fraction and don't redose.

spacing.label: Maximum course
spacing.text: Daily use beyond 2–4 weeks causes dependence. After regular use, never stop suddenly: taper.

benzodiazepines.dependence: Withdrawal after regular use can cause seizures.

risks.title: Breathing
risks.text: With alcohol, opioids or GHB, breathing can stop.

risks.title: Blackouts
risks.text: Memory loss and risky behaviour; you feel less high than you are.

risks.title: Withdrawal seizures
risks.text: After regular use. Taper with medical help.

signs: Very drowsy or can't be woken
actions: Recovery position, call 112
Stay with them
Tell paramedics about alcohol or opioids

maois.dose: Prescription antidepressants or traditional preparations (ayahuasca, Syrian rue). Not used on their own recreationally.
maois.prepare: Check every drug and medication with a pharmacist. With irreversible MAOIs, avoid tyramine-rich foods (aged cheese, cured meat).
maois.marginNote: No safety-ratio data. The danger lies in combinations, not the MAOI alone.

spacing.label: Washout
spacing.text: Irreversible MAOIs keep acting up to 2 weeks after the last dose. Harmala lasts about a day.

risks.title: Serotonin syndrome
risks.text: With MDMA, SSRIs, DXM, tramadol or 5-MeO: often fatal.

risks.title: Hypertensive crisis
risks.text: With stimulants or tyramine-rich food.

risks.title: Ayahuasca
risks.text: Contains MAOIs: the same rules apply.

actions: Call 112 straight away
Cool them down
Tell paramedics which MAOI and what else was taken

ssris.prepare: SSRIs blunt MDMA and psychedelics. Don't skip doses to 'make room': it is risky and destabilising.

spacing.label: Don't stop suddenly
spacing.text: Stopping abruptly can cause discontinuation symptoms: taper with your doctor.

ssris.dependence: Not addictive, but stopping needs a taper.

risks.title: Serotonin syndrome
risks.text: With MAOIs, tramadol, DXM or high-dose MDMA.

risks.title: Weaker effects
risks.text: MDMA feels weaker, which tempts people to redose.

risks.title: Other interactions
risks.text: Lithium and St John's wort also interact.

actions: Call 112
Cool them down
Stop all serotonergic drugs
